title: Change the class on a tradesperson certificate
summary: Learn how to add or change a class on your tradesperson certificate if you gain further qualifications.
intro:
A tradesperson certificate allows drainers, gasfitters, plumbers, roof plumbers and water plumbers to work with minimum supervision.

If you gain further qualifications that allow you to work in additional classes, you can add or change a class on your tradesperson certificate.

You can do this at a service centre.
who_can_apply: Must have gained further qualifications that allow you to work in additional classes.
what_you_need: Documentation that validates the change of class.
Certificate of eligibility to obtain insurance (if applicable).

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and provide the information together with your payment.

more_info.text: You need a medical gas licence to do any medical gas work in NSW, regardless of the work cost or whether it's residential, commercial or industrial.

faqs.a: A tradesperson certificate allows drainers, gasfitters, plumbers, roof plumbers and water plumbers to work with minimum supervision.

faqs.q: How can I change or add a class to my tradesperson certificate?
faqs.a: You can add or change a class on your tradesperson certificate if you gain further qualifications that allow you to work in additional classes. You must do this at a service centre.

faqs.q: Where can I complete the process?
faqs.a: You must visit a service centre to provide the required information and payment.
